streetlist.in {
	route {
		handle /robots.txt {
			header Cache-Control "public, max-age=3600"
			header Content-Type "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
			respond <<ROBOTS
User-agent: *
Disallow: /*/owner
Disallow: /*/o/
Disallow: /*/f/
Disallow: /*/fee/
Disallow: /*/order/
Disallow: /examples/
ROBOTS 200
		}
		@home-live file {
			root /srv/home/current/site
			try_files /index.html
		}
		handle @home-live {
			route {
				# the addresses Firebase's cleanUrls and trailingSlash=false change: the .html and the trailing-slash forms go to the clean one
				@home-index-html path /index.html
				redir @home-index-html / 301
				@home-html path_regexp home-html ^/(shops|partners|privacy|examples/[a-z0-9-]+)\.html$
				redir @home-html /{re.home-html.1} 301
				@home-slash path_regexp home-slash ^/(shops|partners|privacy|examples|examples/[a-z0-9-]+)/$
				redir @home-slash /{re.home-slash.1} 301
				redir /examples /examples/glow-salon 302
				# the home's own addresses: a page, a picture or a hashed file; anything missing under them is the home's 404 page
				@home-area path / /shops /partners /privacy /favicon.svg /examples /examples/* /assets /assets/*
				handle @home-area {
					route {
						# a page is read, not posted to: GET and HEAD only (the door would otherwise take the name for a shop's)
						@home-other-method not method GET HEAD
						header @home-other-method Allow "GET, HEAD"
						respond @home-other-method "Not here" 405
						root * /srv/home/current/site
						encode zstd gzip
						header {
							X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
							Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
							Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=()"
							Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy "same-origin"
							X-Frame-Options "DENY"
							Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000"
						}
						@home-asset path /assets/*
						header @home-asset Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
						@home-page not path /assets/*
						header @home-page Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'"
						header @home-page Cache-Control "no-cache"
						@home-found file {
							try_files {path}.html {path} {path}index.html
						}
						handle @home-found {
							rewrite * {http.matchers.file.relative}
							file_server
						}
						handle {
							header Cache-Control "no-cache"
							rewrite * /404.html
							file_server {
								status 404
							}
						}
					}
				}
				# everything else (a shop's page, /p/<id>, /@handle, the door's own answers) is the door's
				handle {
					reverse_proxy door:8797 {
						@home-nothing header x-geometer-nothing 1
						handle_response @home-nothing {
							root * /srv/home/current/site
							header {
								X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
								Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
								Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=()"
								Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy "same-origin"
								X-Frame-Options "DENY"
								Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000"
								Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'"
								Cache-Control "no-cache"
							}
							rewrite * /404.html
							file_server {
								status 404
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		# no home installed (or none readable): the door alone, as before the home was served here
		handle {
			reverse_proxy door:8797
		}
	}
}

streetlist.co.in {
	reverse_proxy door:8797
}
